definitions.explanation: Someone who entered an organization, school, or profession after you.

examples.japanese: {後輩|こうはい}の{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}る。
{後輩|こうはい}から{相談|そうだん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a consultation from a junior.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{後輩|こうはい}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I met someone who was my junior in university.

notes:
Part of the {先輩|せんぱい}/{後輩|こうはい} (senior/junior) relationship system important in Japanese culture.

USAGE:
・Used as a noun to refer to juniors
・Often used with possessive: {私|わたし}の{後輩|こうはい} (my junior)
・Less commonly used as a direct address (unlike {先輩|せんぱい})

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {先輩|せんぱい}/{後輩|こうはい} system establishes social hierarchy in schools and workplaces. {後輩|こうはい} are expected to show respect to their {先輩|せんぱい}.
